verses.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
verses.pt: Paulo, apóstolo de Cristo Jesus pela vontade de Deus, aos santos que estão em Éfeso, e fiéis em Cristo Jesus:
verses.en_web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:
verses.en_bbe: Paul, an Apostle of Christ Jesus by the purpose of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and those who have faith in Christ Jesus:

verses.en: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Graça a vós, e paz da parte de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
verses.pt: Bendito seja o Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, o qual nos abençoou com todas as bênçãos espirituais nas regiões celestes em Cristo;
verses.en_web: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ;
verses.en_bbe: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has given us every blessing of the Spirit in the heavens in Christ:

verses.en: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
verses.pt: como também nos elegeu nele antes da fundação do mundo, para sermos santos e irrepreensíveis diante dele em amor;
verses.en_web: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love;
verses.en_bbe: Even as he made selection of us in him from the first, so that we might be holy and free from all evil before him in love:

verses.en: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
verses.pt: e nos predestinou para sermos filhos de adoção por Jesus Cristo, para si mesmo, segundo o beneplácito de sua vontade,
verses.en_web: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,
verses.en_bbe: As we were designed before by him for the position of sons to himself, through Jesus Christ, in the good pleasure of his purpose,

verses.en: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
verses.pt: para o louvor da glória da sua graça, a qual nos deu gratuitamente no Amado;
verses.en_web: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved,
verses.en_bbe: To the praise of the glory of his grace, which he freely gave to us in the Loved One:

verses.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
verses.pt: em quem temos a redenção pelo seu sangue, a redenção dos nossos delitos, segundo as riquezas da sua graça,
verses.en_web: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,
verses.en_bbe: In whom we have salvation through his blood, the forgiveness of our sins, through the wealth of his grace,

verses.en: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
verses.pt: que ele fez abundar para conosco em toda a sabedoria e prudência,
verses.en_web: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
verses.en_bbe: Which he gave us in full measure in all wisdom and care;

verses.en: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
verses.pt: fazendo-nos conhecer o mistério da sua vontade, segundo o seu beneplácito, que nele propôs
verses.en_web: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
verses.en_bbe: Having made clear to us the secret of his purpose, in agreement with the design which he had in mind, to put into his hands

verses.en: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
verses.pt: para a dispensação da plenitude dos tempos, de fazer convergir em Cristo todas as coisas, tanto as que estão nos céus como as que estão na terra,
verses.en_web: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things on the earth, in him;
verses.en_bbe: The ordering of the times when they are complete, so that all things might come to a head in Christ, the things in heaven and the things on the earth; in him, I say,

verses.en: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
verses.pt: nele, digo, no qual também fomos feitos herança, havendo sido predestinados conforme o propósito daquele que faz todas as coisas segundo o conselho da sua vontade,
verses.en_web: in whom also we were assigned an inheritance, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will;
verses.en_bbe: In whom we have a heritage, being marked out from the first in his purpose who does all things in agreement with his designs;

verses.en: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
verses.pt: com o fim de sermos para o louvor da sua glória, nós, os que antes havíamos esperado em Cristo;
verses.en_web: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.
verses.en_bbe: So that his glory might have praise through us who first had hope in Christ:

verses.en: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
verses.pt: no qual também vós, tendo ouvido a palavra da verdade, o evangelho da vossa salvação, e tendo nele também crido, fostes selados com o Espírito Santo da promessa,
verses.en_web: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
verses.en_bbe: In whom you, having been given the true word, the good news of your salvation, and through your faith in him, were given the sign of the Holy Spirit of hope,

verses.en: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
verses.pt: o qual é o penhor da nossa herança, para redenção da possessão de Deus, para o louvor da sua glória.
verses.en_web: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
verses.en_bbe: Which is the first-fruit of our heritage, till God gets back that which is his, to the praise of his glory.

verses.en: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
verses.pt: Por isso também eu, tendo ouvido falar da fé que entre vós há no Senhor Jesus e do vosso amor para com todos os santos,
verses.en_web: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which you have toward all the saints,
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I, having had news of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and which you make clear to all the saints,

verses.en: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
verses.pt: não cesso de dar graças por vós, lembrando-me de vós nas minhas orações,
verses.en_web: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,
verses.en_bbe: Give praise without end for you, keeping you in mind in my prayers;

verses.en: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
verses.pt: para que o Deus de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, o Pai da glória, vos dê o espírito de sabedoria e de revelação no pleno conhecimento dele;
verses.en_web: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;
verses.en_bbe: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;

verses.en: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
verses.pt: sendo iluminados os olhos do vosso coração, para que saibais qual seja a esperança da sua vocação, e quais as riquezas da glória da sua herança nos santos,
verses.en_web: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
verses.en_bbe: And that having the eyes of your heart full of light, you may have knowledge of what is the hope of his purpose, what is the wealth of the glory of his heritage in the saints,

verses.en: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
verses.pt: e qual a suprema grandeza do seu poder para conosco, os que cremos, segundo a operação da força do seu poder,
verses.en_web: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
verses.en_bbe: And how unlimited is his power to us who have faith, as is seen in the working of the strength of his power,

verses.en: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
verses.pt: que operou em Cristo, ressuscitando-o dentre os mortos e fazendo-o sentar-se à sua direita nos céus,
verses.en_web: which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,
verses.en_bbe: By which he made Christ come back from the dead, and gave him a place at his right hand in heaven,

verses.en: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
verses.pt: muito acima de todo principado, e autoridade, e poder, e domínio, e de todo nome que se nomeia, não só neste século, mas também no vindouro;
verses.en_web: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.
verses.en_bbe: Far over all rule and authority and power and every name which is named, not only in the present order, but in that which is to come:

verses.en: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
verses.pt: e sujeitou todas as coisas debaixo dos seus pés, e para ser cabeça sobre todas as coisas o deu à igreja,
verses.en_web: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
verses.en_bbe: And he has put all things under his feet, and has made him to be head over all things to the church,

verses.en: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
verses.pt: que é o seu corpo, o complemento daquele que cumpre tudo em todas as coisas.
verses.en_web: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
verses.en_bbe: Which is his body, the full measure of him in whom all things are made complete.
